data.one_liner: A collection of customizable icons with multiple styles and payment logos.
data.what_it_does: Provides over 5,000 icons spanning outlined, filled, broken, bulk, two-tone styles, and payment brand logos. Uses icon fonts and optimized SVG rendering for performance.
use_when: You need a large collection of styled icons and payment method logos.
You want optimized icon fonts with opacity effects and type-safe accessors.
avoid_when: You need country flag icons (which were removed in version 3.0.0).
You want to keep bundle size to an absolute minimum without needing a large icon library.
strengths: Offers 5,000+ icons across multiple distinct visual styles.
Includes payment method and cryptocurrency logos with original brand colors.
weaknesses: Country flags were removed, requiring an alternative package if needed.
Breaking changes can occur with icon name typos fixed in updates.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the desired icon styles.

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: For a widely adopted, standard icon set with extensive brand and solid icons.

alternatives.name: material_symbols_icons
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the official Google Material Symbols icon collection.

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the clean Lucide icon set.
